title: lycopodium complanatum var. anceps
intro: Lycopodium complanatum var. anceps, commonly known as club moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family and is native to the tropical regions of Australia and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium complanatum var. anceps include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve headaches and migraines, and treat menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lycopodine, a sesquiterpene, and beta-amyrin, a triterpenoid, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
